note: #8359 batch 32: twelve probes grouped by shared fixtures. Runtime proof remains required; own insert paths are compared independently of replay.

civic_local_jurisdictions_for_org(p_org.reason: #8359 batch 32: Read all real chapter jurisdictions, including the batch31 entry; other organization/chapter entries must be unavailable. Civic authority is chapter-wide, so units reuse the chapter fixture.

civic_local_officials_for_org(p_org text.reason: #8359 batch 32: Read a real nonempty chapter official roster through its jurisdiction. Compare every field; other chapter/org rosters cannot affect it. Units reuse the chapter official.

discard_form_draft(p_form_id uuid).reason: #8359 batch 32: Discard a separate unsubmitted, case-less, attachment-free own non-sealed draft on a free template slot. Inspect real deletion and exact returned id before rollback; foreign and missing drafts must be refused alike.

export_ballot_nominations(p_ballot_id te.reason: #8359 batch 32: Export the same real chapter ballot nomination through the journaled writer. Require full stable nomination payload; foreign organization/chapter and absent ballots must be refused alike. Units share the chapter ballot.

get_ballot_nominations(p_ballot_id text).reason: #8359 batch 32: Reuse the chapter draft ballot and real batch29 nomination. Compare full staff payload with no generated-id mask; foreign organization/chapter and absent ballots must be campaign not found. Units share chapter governance.

get_broadcast_read_counts_for(p_broadcas.reason: #8359 batch 32: Read the real authored chapter or unit notice with one in-audience receipt; an unauthorized or missing notice is omitted. Published timestamps and ordering positions are untied.

get_digital_action_goal_breakdown(p_acti.reason: #8359 batch 32: Read a real published organization petition with a participant and nonempty goal breakdown. Same-organization chapters/units intentionally share it; only another organization adds a different action.

get_learning_workspace(p_chapter_id text.reason: #8359 batch 32: Read a nonempty chapter learning workspace containing the existing batch29 authored content. Compare its complete projection and policy. Foreign and missing chapter context must be refused alike; unit worlds reuse chapter content.

get_member_notice_receipts(p_broadcast_i.reason: #8359 batch 32: Read the actual author-owned notice and its in-audience member receipt; compare full counts/readers and match independent foreign/missing refusals.

retract_member_broadcast(p_broadcast_id.reason: #8359 batch 32: Retract the real authored notice; require exact id/retracted return and stored transaction timestamp, with every other notice/receipt unchanged before rollback.

revoke_integration_api_key(p_key_id uuid.reason: #8359 batch 32: Revoke the existing organization key, inspect revoked_at and the complete returned key list before rollback; other organization keys/integrations remain unchanged. Same-org chapter/unit worlds reuse that key.

toggle_digital_action_participation(p_ac.reason: #8359 batch 32: Participate in the real published organization petition. Compare replay in the sweep, plus independent fresh own-persona insert samples with/without the neighbour and a repeat control; inspect every other participant before rollback.
